_comment: REGRESSION GUARD on a real defect this deck found (2026-10-01). rider_delta priced an attach off the FLAT equip_power_bonus, which is 0 for a per-equipment scaler, and the equip-emission gate drops a host scoring 0 -- so Golem-Skin Gauntlets was castable and NEVER equippable in the pruned search, while human play (which opens every host) equipped it fine, making the hole invisible in hand-played reference games. Both attach rankers now call the shared EquipAttachDeltaFor. Deliberately NO MTG_HUMAN_PLAY and NO MTG_UNPRUNED here: the whole point is that the PRUNED search emits the line. A bare Puresteel host makes the delta unambiguous (the Gauntlets alone grants +1).
